snippet.title: Lost Host - Announcement Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10020878

Lost Host is coming to PlayStation®5 in 2027!

Embark on a heartfelt adventure as a small RC car searching for a missing boy. Explore a world from a toy's perspective, solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and uncover the mystery behind his disappearance.

Wishlist Lost Host now on PlayStation Store!
